claim: A selected enabled heuristic can evaluate one exact bounded policy/example snapshot through an optional local or native-approved API route and retain an immutable attributed pass/fail/uncertain result with mandatory rationale, uncertainty, exact verified policy spans, and route provenance.
verified: The request freezes only project/document identity, one enabled heuristic, active examples, and deterministic semantic policy text under explicit size bounds
Local, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and xAI routes share one strict route-bound result contract

Every accepted result has a pass/fail/uncertain verdict, non-empty rationale and uncertainty, and one or more sorted non-overlapping citations whose quotes exactly equal the supplied UTF-16 policy spans
Malformed or command-bearing structured output receives at most one repair attempt and then fails closed
Cancellation and route mismatch prevent a result; adapter/network failures are not silently retried
Remote tasks carry only the selected heuristic/examples and exact policy snapshot through the native Send once boundary
Before any provider work, the product rejects invalid shared result/example history and builds from the current live heuristic/editor snapshot
Commit rechecks project/document identity plus exact policy, heuristic, and active-example revisions; stale work adds no record
Results are immutable attributed peer-namespaced records; exact replay is idempotent, identity reuse fails closed, and disconnected peer results converge without overwrite
The product exposes provider/model, verdict, rationale, residual uncertainty, verified quotes/offsets, researcher attribution, run, and source revision while remaining usable with local AI off
Research-state/MCP inspection exposes only result/verdict/route counts and integrity; rationale, uncertainty, citation text, and policy bodies are omitted with secret canaries
Production TypeScript and Vite build passes
limitations: No live paid-provider call or model-quality/semantic-correctness benchmark is included; provider behavior is injected and deterministic.
A citation can be textually exact yet misleading, incomplete, or attached to unsound rationale; human review remains required.
Researcher identity and timestamps are installation/caller supplied and are not authenticated or trusted across installs.
No packaged pointer/keyboard interaction or two-physical-install result-convergence run is included.
No manual verdict override, result supersession/outdated filter, or bulk evaluation queue is included.
An offline collaborator change not yet delivered cannot be predicted; results remain historical records after later edits.
